name: katalon-true-platform
description: Agent-neutral AI testing skills for Katalon True Platform covering the full software testing lifecycle: test planning, test design, test management and requirement traceability, test review, manual and automated execution with AI, failure analysis and release readiness, and test maintenance - operated through the Katalon MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Design, run, upload, and analyze Katalon tests.
interface.longDescription: Bundle Katalon True Platform/TestOps workflows for MCP setup, requirement-based manual test creation, manual and automated execution, Playwright automation generation, Playwright execution with report upload, and release readiness analysis.
defaultPrompt: Install the Katalon MCP server and connect it to my platform account.
Plan testing for this sprint: show coverage gaps and build the executable suite.
Design and import manual test cases from requirement CEL-6.
Audit requirement-to-test traceability and list orphan requirements.
Review this suite for the pipeline and give a verdict with weak cases.
